verdict.rationale: The skill ships as a folder you copy into your own personal or project skills directory. Its Python tools are dependency-free and run locally, and the reference library is browsable in a local gallery. It uses the open Agent Skills format, so it works in any agent that supports skills. However, it still depends on a host agent runtime such as Claude, and the evidence never shows a fully self-contained deployment. missing for 10: documented use with a self-hosted or local-model agent runtime, an explicit open-source license or self-hosting guide, independent corroboration of local-only operation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
